title: Tiny Heart Applique
description: A small decorative heart for practicing shaping in one quick round.
expectationText: A tiny shaped motif that teaches how stitch height changes the outline of a design.

steps.title: Make the ring
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring and chain 2 to begin the heart shape.

steps.title: Build the lobes
steps.instruction: Work taller stitches into the ring to form the rounded top of the heart.

steps.title: Shape the point
steps.instruction: Use shorter stitches, then one taller stitch at the bottom point.

steps.title: Close the heart
steps.instruction: Mirror the first side, slip stitch to close, and pull the ring tight.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave the tails into the back of the heart.
